title: Differential addition on Jacobi quartic Curves
summary: In this paper we present new differential addition and doubling formulas for Jacobi quartic curves. Several differential addition and doubling formulas are presented with cost of 5M+4S+1D,3M+7S+1D,3M+6S+3D when the given difference point is in affine form. Here M,S,D denote the costs of a field multiplication, a field squaring and a field multiplication by a constant, respectively.
